title: odontosoria clavata

It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of Odontosoria clavata have been shown to possess therapeutic potential in treating various diseases, including cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders.
